    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">零基础认识大语言模型（LLM）工作原理(12.Workflow：为什么企业 AI 都离不开工作流？)</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h1 class="XYd-Qa_Headline" data-w-component="title" data-w-weight="semibold" data-w-size="2xl">第十二章 Workflow：为什么企业 AI 都离不开工作流？</h1>
<h2 class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="1mpo7k2" data-start="613" data-end="633">目录</h2>
<p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="1mpo7k2" data-start="613" data-end="633"><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/GuZhenYin/p/20983335">零基础认识大语言模型（LLM）工作原理目录 - GuZhenYin - 博客园</a></p>
<h2 class="XYd-Qa_Headline" data-w-component="title" data-w-weight="semibold" data-w-size="xl">本章导读</h2>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">上一章我们介绍了 MCP，它解决的是：AI 如何连接工具。</p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">但是企业在真正使用 AI 时，很快又会发现另一个问题。</p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">例如，一个采购审批流程：</p>
<ul class="Ck6QPa_List" data-w-component="list" data-w-variant="native-unordered">
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">读取采购申请</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">检查库存</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">判断是否超预算</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">发送审批</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">等待结果</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">通知仓库</p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">这一串操作,就不是“调用一个工具”能完成的事情了。</p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">它需要：</p>
<ul class="Ck6QPa_List" data-w-component="list" data-w-variant="native-unordered">
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">顺序执行</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">条件判断</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">等待外部结果</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">失败重试</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">状态管理</p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">这时候，仅靠 LLM+Tool Call 已经不够了。</p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-weight="semibold" data-w-wrap="normal">于是 Workflow（工作流）出现了。</p>
<div class="duPRdW_Divider" data-w-component="divider">&nbsp;</div>
<h2 class="XYd-Qa_Headline" data-w-component="title" data-w-weight="semibold" data-w-size="xl">12.1 为什么 LLM 不适合控制流程？</h2>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">我们还是先看一个简单任务：<strong>帮我统计 Excel 销售额。</strong></p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">LLM 可以一次完成</p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">但是一旦用户把任务变成：<strong>每天自动读取销售数据，如果低于目标就给负责人发消息。</strong></p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">那么问题就来了</p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">因为这里出现了：</p>
<ul class="Ck6QPa_List" data-w-component="list" data-w-variant="native-unordered">
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">时间触发</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">条件判断</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">循环执行</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">异常处理</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">长期运行</p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">而 LLM 的特点是：</p>
<div class="ac5DTa_Box" data-w-direction="row" data-w-align="stretch" data-w-has-width="" data-w-component="row">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-has-width="" data-w-component="box">&nbsp;一次请求 → 一次推理 → 结束。</div>
</div>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">所以它并不是一个长期运行的流程引擎。</p>
<div class="duPRdW_Divider" data-w-component="divider">&nbsp;</div>
<h2>12.2 Workflow 的本质是什么？</h2>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">我们先概括一下:&nbsp;<strong>Workflow等于用确定性的流程，组织不确定性的 AI 能力。</strong></p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">这里面有两个关键词：</p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal"><strong>确定性</strong></p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">例如：</p>
<ul class="Ck6QPa_List" data-w-component="list" data-w-variant="native-unordered">
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">先查库存</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">再审批</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">最后发通知</p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">这些步骤顺序是固定的。</p>
<div class="duPRdW_Divider" data-w-component="divider">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="duPRdW_Divider" data-w-component="divider"><strong>不确定性</strong></div>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">例如：</p>
<ul class="Ck6QPa_List" data-w-component="list" data-w-variant="native-unordered">
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">审批意见如何生成？</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">邮件怎么写？</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">问题如何总结？</p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">这些更适合交给 LLM</p>
<div class="duPRdW_Divider" data-w-component="divider">所以,我们就需要 Workflow 负责“流程”，LLM 负责“智能”。</div>
<div class="duPRdW_Divider" data-w-component="divider">&nbsp;</div>
<h2 class="XYd-Qa_Headline" data-w-component="title" data-w-weight="semibold" data-w-size="xl">12.3 一个最小工作流</h2>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">假设我们做一个“日报生成”流程：</p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-weight="semibold" data-w-wrap="normal">流程图：</p>
<div class="ac5DTa_Box" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-has-height="" data-w-has-width="" data-w-component="box">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box gvjAwW_ImageBox" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-has-height="" data-w-has-width="" data-w-component="image"><img src="https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/fl2JLtICi6KPaIWYqWQntC2_9ZBe1WXw3a1L40CDKcOFQ9-RFbYEN1pRCLJlMs2Fd8eYMqh9hINfAi8Hr8koctsNKi-5QaCeZK5P2eUlFWAO8OnKQKgUaedx48eXyXKXjasqGrX4chga10nrKuhCL0XA3tMSaopYPUE4mINK7GKM5PJYaaK4cJvfCzLOBVRx?purpose=fullsize" alt="Markifact - AI Marketing Automation" width="694" height="356" class="CrFGHG_Image gvjAwW_Image" data-loaded=""></div>
</div>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">对应步骤：</p>
<ul class="Ck6QPa_List" data-w-component="list" data-w-variant="native-unordered">
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">读取数据库</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">统计数据</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">调用 LLM 生成摘要</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">发送邮件</p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">注意：</p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-weight="semibold" data-w-wrap="normal">这里只有第 3 步用了 AI。</p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">其他步骤则全部是普通程序。</p>
<div class="duPRdW_Divider" data-w-component="divider">&nbsp;</div>
<h2 class="XYd-Qa_Headline" data-w-component="title" data-w-weight="semibold" data-w-size="xl">12.4 为什么企业特别需要 Workflow？</h2>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">因为企业系统天然就是流程化的。</p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">例如医院 SPD：</p>
<div class="ac5DTa_Box" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-has-height="" data-w-has-width="" data-w-component="box">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box gvjAwW_ImageBox" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-has-height="" data-w-has-width="" data-w-component="image"><img src="https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/sySiA-N1E4UKS-s2oaytv3ucCX-uzk-IIlujgbKXZ12DN2eCrVJHEy98AXehN3qshr3zal2ndG8jgmxo7OtQPZHzbTPrOgxI5wUVeUnPrlMRhooLYk9pRDnFwriVeUrPl_Z15ERlToctXY-ljjjYvvO_Ug8aLxSCBBfGMg49jW6py1jOqk1JzrIP3x_yWFRu?purpose=fullsize" alt="医院SPD供应链管理系统详解，如何提升医疗效率？ • 简道云" width="608" height="405" class="CrFGHG_Image gvjAwW_Image" data-loaded=""></div>
</div>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">这里最关键的是：<strong>流程必须可控、可追踪、可审计。</strong></p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">然而 LLM则本身并不具备这些能力。</p>
<div class="duPRdW_Divider" data-w-component="divider">&nbsp;</div>
<h3 class="XYd-Qa_Headline" data-w-component="title" data-w-weight="semibold" data-w-size="xl">12.5 Workflow 与 Agent 有什么区别？</h3>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">这是比较容易混淆的地方。</p>
<div class="oVf2pG_TableContainer" data-w-column-sizing="equal" data-w-component="table-scroll">
<table class="oVf2pG_Table" data-w-column-sizing="equal" data-w-component="table">
<thead>
<tr class="oVf2pG_Row" data-w-component="table-row"><th class="oVf2pG_Cell" scope="col" data-w-component="table-cell">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-weight="semibold" data-w-wrap="normal">Workflow</p>
</th><th class="oVf2pG_Cell" scope="col" data-w-component="table-cell">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-weight="semibold" data-w-wrap="normal">Agent</p>
</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="oVf2pG_Row" data-w-component="table-row">
<td class="oVf2pG_Cell" data-w-component="table-cell">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">流程预先定义</p>
</td>
<td class="oVf2pG_Cell" data-w-component="table-cell">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">步骤动态决定</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr class="oVf2pG_Row" data-w-component="table-row">
<td class="oVf2pG_Cell" data-w-component="table-cell">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">可预测</p>
</td>
<td class="oVf2pG_Cell" data-w-component="table-cell">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">更灵活</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr class="oVf2pG_Row" data-w-component="table-row">
<td class="oVf2pG_Cell" data-w-component="table-cell">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">适合企业流程</p>
</td>
<td class="oVf2pG_Cell" data-w-component="table-cell">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">适合复杂开放任务</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr class="oVf2pG_Row" data-w-component="table-row">
<td class="oVf2pG_Cell" data-w-component="table-cell">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">强调稳定</p>
</td>
<td class="oVf2pG_Cell" data-w-component="table-cell">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">强调自主性</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr class="oVf2pG_Row" data-w-component="table-row">
<td class="oVf2pG_Cell" data-w-component="table-cell">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">像 BPM 系统</p>
</td>
<td class="oVf2pG_Cell" data-w-component="table-cell">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">像智能员工</p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<div class="duPRdW_Divider" data-w-component="divider">&nbsp;</div>
<h2 class="XYd-Qa_Headline" data-w-component="title" data-w-weight="semibold" data-w-size="xl">12.6 什么时候用 Workflow？什么时候用 Agent？</h2>
<h3 class="XYd-Qa_Headline" data-w-component="title" data-w-weight="semibold" data-w-size="lg">适合 Workflow 的场景</h3>
<ul class="Ck6QPa_List" data-w-component="list" data-w-variant="native-unordered">
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">审批</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">报表</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">通知</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">数据同步</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">ERP 流程</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">医院业务流程</p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
<div class="duPRdW_Divider" data-w-component="divider">&nbsp;</div>
<h3 class="XYd-Qa_Headline" data-w-component="title" data-w-weight="semibold" data-w-size="lg">适合 Agent 的场景</h3>
<ul class="Ck6QPa_List" data-w-component="list" data-w-variant="native-unordered">
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">代码开发</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">复杂调研</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">多步分析</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">开放式问题解决</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">自动化运维</p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
<div class="duPRdW_Divider" data-w-component="divider">&nbsp;</div>
<h2 class="XYd-Qa_Headline" data-w-component="title" data-w-weight="semibold" data-w-size="xl">12.7 实际案例：以 Dify Workflow 为例</h2>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">前面我们讲的是原理。</p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">现在来看一个真实的开源产品(它带火了2025年的AI浪潮)</p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal"><span class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text rFU14q_Emphasis" data-w-component="bold" data-w-default-strong="" data-w-inline="" data-w-wrap="normal">Dify 的 Workflow 其实本质上就是一个可视化流程编排器。</span></p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">典型流程：</p>
<div class="ac5DTa_Box" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-has-height="" data-w-has-width="" data-w-component="box">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box gvjAwW_ImageBox" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-has-height="" data-w-has-width="" data-w-component="image">
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/653851/202607/653851-20260710094018470-772026945.png" alt="image" width="1607" height="301" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
</div>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">其中：</p>
<div class="oVf2pG_TableContainer" data-w-column-sizing="equal" data-w-component="table-scroll">
<table class="oVf2pG_Table" data-w-column-sizing="equal" data-w-component="table">
<thead>
<tr class="oVf2pG_Row" data-w-component="table-row"><th class="oVf2pG_Cell" scope="col" data-w-component="table-cell">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-weight="semibold" data-w-wrap="normal">节点</p>
</th><th class="oVf2pG_Cell" scope="col" data-w-component="table-cell">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-weight="semibold" data-w-wrap="normal">作用</p>
</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="oVf2pG_Row" data-w-component="table-row">
<td class="oVf2pG_Cell" data-w-component="table-cell">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">LLM</p>
</td>
<td class="oVf2pG_Cell" data-w-component="table-cell">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">生成内容</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr class="oVf2pG_Row" data-w-component="table-row">
<td class="oVf2pG_Cell" data-w-component="table-cell">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">IF</p>
</td>
<td class="oVf2pG_Cell" data-w-component="table-cell">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">条件判断</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr class="oVf2pG_Row" data-w-component="table-row">
<td class="oVf2pG_Cell" data-w-component="table-cell">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">HTTP</p>
</td>
<td class="oVf2pG_Cell" data-w-component="table-cell">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">调用 API</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr class="oVf2pG_Row" data-w-component="table-row">
<td class="oVf2pG_Cell" data-w-component="table-cell">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">Code</p>
</td>
<td class="oVf2pG_Cell" data-w-component="table-cell">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">执行代码</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr class="oVf2pG_Row" data-w-component="table-row">
<td class="oVf2pG_Cell" data-w-component="table-cell">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">End</p>
</td>
<td class="oVf2pG_Cell" data-w-component="table-cell">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">输出结果</p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">这里,我们就可以发现：</p>
<div class="ac5DTa_Box" data-w-direction="row" data-w-align="stretch" data-w-has-width="" data-w-component="row">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-has-width="" data-w-component="box">Dify 的核心并不是 LLM，而是“流程编排”。</div>
</div>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">LLM的调用只是其中一个节点。</p>
<div class="duPRdW_Divider" data-w-component="divider">&nbsp;</div>
<h2 class="XYd-Qa_Headline" data-w-component="title" data-w-weight="semibold" data-w-size="xl">12.8 组合才能更佳</h2>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">很多人以为：</p>
<div class="ac5DTa_Box" data-w-direction="row" data-w-align="stretch" data-w-has-width="" data-w-component="row">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-has-width="" data-w-component="box">&nbsp;AI 应用等于调用大模型。</div>
</div>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">但是在实际应用过程中,企业里的 AI应该是Workflow + LLM的组合</p>
<div class="ac5DTa_Box" data-w-direction="row" data-w-align="stretch" data-w-has-width="" data-w-component="row">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-component="col">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-weight="semibold" data-w-wrap="normal">真正稳定的 AI 系统，往往是“Workflow + LLM”的组合，而不是单纯的大模型。</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="duPRdW_Divider" data-w-component="divider">&nbsp;</div>
<h2 class="XYd-Qa_Headline" data-w-component="title" data-w-weight="semibold" data-w-size="xl">本章总结</h2>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">这一章，我们解决了四个关键问题：</p>
<div class="duPRdW_Divider" data-w-component="divider">①为什么 LLM 不适合控制流程？</div>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">因为它是一次性推理，不擅长长期运行与状态管理。</p>
<div class="duPRdW_Divider" data-w-component="divider">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="ac5DTa_Box" data-w-direction="row" data-w-align="center" data-w-wrap="wrap" data-w-component="row">
<div class="ANObbW_Badge mduyaG_Badge" data-color="info" data-size="sm" data-pill="" data-variant="soft" data-w-component="badge" data-w-weight="medium" data-w-hover-variant="soft">②Workflow 的本质是什么？</div>
</div>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">用确定性的流程组织 AI 能力。</p>
<div class="duPRdW_Divider" data-w-component="divider">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="ac5DTa_Box" data-w-direction="row" data-w-align="center" data-w-wrap="wrap" data-w-component="row">
<div class="ANObbW_Badge mduyaG_Badge" data-color="info" data-size="sm" data-pill="" data-variant="soft" data-w-component="badge" data-w-weight="medium" data-w-hover-variant="soft">③Workflow 与 Agent 的区别？</div>
</div>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">Workflow 强调稳定和可控，Agent 强调灵活和自主。</p>
<div class="duPRdW_Divider" data-w-component="divider">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="ac5DTa_Box" data-w-direction="row" data-w-align="center" data-w-wrap="wrap" data-w-component="row">
<div class="ANObbW_Badge mduyaG_Badge" data-color="info" data-size="sm" data-pill="" data-variant="soft" data-w-component="badge" data-w-weight="medium" data-w-hover-variant="soft">④Dify 的核心价值是什么？</div>
</div>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">不是“大模型”，而是“可视化工作流编排”。</p>

</div>
